replacements.anchor: # H. Prior-free derivation of known machine-intelligence families
replacements.new: - [x] Basis/kernel methods. — ✅ gmi-833-h-real-scale-revival-v1 RSR-3 RSR-5: one unchanged grammar (6324 pairs, digest 60bc1a6e3b65) blind-chose the lifted per-input basis STEP(ARG) | MUL(BIAS,S) on 438739/87747 fit/held-out rows of the sha256-bound ALSA PCM, held-out exact SSE 406.046x below the affine arm and strictly positive, landmark cost crossover q*=2, all 11 gates at SIGMA_R04B.

failed_predictions.attribution: Q2a is a conjunction: BODY semantically MUL(ARG,PARAM), HEAD semantically ADD(S,BIAS), class AFFINE_SCORE, no STATE. The family-blind search chose MUL(ARG,PARAM) | ADD(S,S). The body clause and the class clause held; the head clause did not, because ADD(S,S) is 2S, a linear head with no intercept, a different denotation from ADD(S,BIAS). Diagnosis: the prediction over-specified. The top eight ranked candidates are all AFFINE_SCORE and their out-of-sample squared errors on 26325 ranking-score rows lie within 26489 parts per billion of one another (5.40444, 5.40457, 5.40458), and the fitted intercept was 0 at the registered rationalisation, so this ecology has no intercept to identify. The class is identified and stable across the regeneration and across the V3 ranking correction; the expression within the class is not. The clause that held is reported as a labelled diagnostic and is NOT substituted for the conjunction that failed.

Q2h asserted that the support-admissibility rule is inert at this scope AND that the chosen program is byte-identical to the first run's. The inertness clause held, 0 of 6324 candidates demoted. The identity clause failed because the V3 ranking correction, registered for an independent defect, moved the chosen head from ADD(BIAS,S) to ADD(S,S).

The family-blind search chose STEP(ARG) | MUL(BIAS,RECIP(S)), class LIFTED_BASIS, where NONLINEAR_LINK was registered. The single lever of FREEZE_V2_ADDENDUM.md, a generic support-admissibility rule, fired non-vacuously (484 of 6324 demoted) and removed the affine score the first run chose, but did not produce a link. Second attribution: under a generic squared loss on a real over-dispersed count response, non-negativity is cheaper to buy by lifting the INPUT than by bending the LINK, because a per-input indicator makes the fold value non-negative before the head is applied. Identifying the link plausibly needs a loss proper for counts, and a proper scoring rule is exactly the family information the search may not receive. Per FREEZE_V2_ADDENDUM.md section 6 this is not attempted a third time in this package.

The regeneration on the disjoint slices chose MUL(ARG,PARAM) | ABS(RECIP(S)), class NONLINEAR_LINK, against the main run's LIFTED_BASIS. The two routes to admissibility are close in loss at this scope, so the recovered class is not stable. Same stage as Q3a.

rows_not_in_scope.note: The five Section-H rows the requirement ledger scores at 7 of 11 - Bayesian inference/belief-state systems., Feed-forward neural networks., CNN/equivariant local-weight-sharing systems., Flow-like transport systems., Energy-based systems. - were NOT attempted.
